scripts.deploy:check-clean: [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || { echo 'Aborting: uncommitted changes. Commit or stash first.'; exit 1; }
scripts.deploy:check-main: git checkout -q main && git fetch -q origin main && [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" ] || { echo 'Aborting: could not switch to main, or main is not in sync with origin/main.'; exit 1; }
scripts.deploy:at22: pnpm run deploy:check-clean && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=at22 pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --env at22
scripts.deploy:at23: pnpm run deploy:check-clean && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=at23 pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --env at23
scripts.deploy:tt02: pnpm run deploy:check-clean && pnpm run deploy:check-main && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=tt02 pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --env tt02
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm run deploy:check-clean && pnpm run deploy:check-main && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=prod pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --env prod
